features.name: Spellcasting
features.description: Wisdom is the Spiritbound Marksman's spellcasting ability. Spell save DC 15 and spell attack bonus +7.

features.name: Spiritfire Gun
features.description: The marksman channels spiritual energy through a Spiritfire Gun. Attacks use Wisdom and deal 1d10 force damage. At 5th level, two separate shots are fired.

features.name: Lesser Echo Marks
features.description: Once per turn when making a Spiritfire Gun attack, the marksman may apply a Lesser Echo Mark.

features.name: Agonizing Echo
features.description: Add the marksman's Wisdom modifier to each Spiritfire Gun shot.

features.name: Path of the Deadeye
features.description: The Spiritfire Gun takes the form of a tactical Six-Shooter with a normal range of 60 feet and a long range of 120 feet.

features.name: Death's Brand
features.description: Once per turn, when the marksman hits with a Spiritfire Gun shot, they may mark the target. If the marked creature is hit again before the brand expires, the brand is consumed and deals additional necrotic damage.

features.name: Mark of the Last Breath
features.description: Death's Brand lasts until the end of the marksman's next turn and deals 2d6 necrotic damage when triggered. Once per long rest, the marksman may mark a second creature.

features.name: Bardic Inspiration
features.description: As a bonus action, the bard grants one creature a d8 Bardic Inspiration die.

features.name: Jack of All Trades
features.description: The bard adds half their proficiency bonus to ability checks that do not already include their proficiency bonus.

features.name: Song of Rest
features.description: Creatures who regain hit points during a short rest regain an additional 1d6 hit points.

features.name: Expertise
features.description: The bard has Expertise in two chosen skill proficiencies.

features.name: Font of Inspiration
features.description: Bardic Inspiration uses are regained after a short or long rest.

features.name: Cutting Words
features.description: As a reaction, the bard can expend a Bardic Inspiration die and subtract the roll from an enemy's attack roll, ability check, or damage roll.

features.name: Additional Magical Secrets
features.description: The bard learns two additional spells from any class. This bard has learned Fireball and Counterspell.

features.name: +1 Magic Focus
features.description: This magical spellcasting focus grants +1 to spell attack rolls and +1 to spell save DC.

features.name: Rage
features.description: While raging, the barbarian gains advantage on Strength checks and Strength saving throws, +2 damage with Strength-based melee weapon attacks, and resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage.

features.name: Unarmored Defense
features.description: While not wearing armor, AC equals 10 + Dexterity modifier + Constitution modifier.

features.name: Reckless Attack
features.description: The barbarian may gain advantage on Strength-based melee weapon attacks during their turn, but attacks against them have advantage until their next turn.

features.name: Danger Sense
features.description: The barbarian has advantage on Dexterity saving throws against effects they can see.

features.name: Extra Attack
features.description: The barbarian can attack twice whenever they take the Attack action.

features.name: Fast Movement
features.description: Movement speed increases by 10 feet while not wearing heavy armor.
